worst_unit: Fix Verificatio — title truncated mid-word, and its single 290-char span is a whole-turn quote rather than a targeted evidence slice
issues: Title 'Fix Verificatio' is truncated mid-word within the 15-char limit; a fitting alternative (e.g. 'Fix Tests Pass') existed.

User process constraints are not surfaced in any summary: the no-production-restart ground rule (t000), the 10-minute soak bar (t008, invoked repeatedly at t029/t044), and the no-new-dependencies constraint (t024) all fall inside covered turns but appear in no sentence; salient_infos arrays are uniformly empty.

Multi-clause sentences are frequently backed by a single span that evidences only one clause: 'nine .on() sites' (Listener Audit), 'env-tunable' (Cache Fix Plan), 'slowed from 65 to 27 MB/min' (Leak Ongoing), 'never clears setInterval' (Heartbeat Cause), 'exactly one pong listener' (Mechanism OK), and the messageCache clause of Final Summary have no span backing, though the claims are accurate.
The two-hypothesis framing at t007 (listener leak vs unbounded cache), which structures the whole investigation, is absent from the 'Heap Diff' unit summary.
Mild over-fragmentation: 17 units for 50 turns, with five 2-turn units; 'Heap Diff' could merge into 'Leak Reproduced' and 'Cache Fix Plan' into 'Cache Discovery' without losing navigability.
Turn t012 (reading connection.js, the direct continuation of the listener audit announced at t011) is grouped into 'Emitter Counts' rather than 'Listener Audit'.
strengths: Dead-end vs conclusion handling is excellent: 'Listener Parked' says parked (not disproven), 'Emitter Counts' precisely scopes the negative result to shared emitters, and 'Retainer Path'/'Heartbeat Cause' correctly represent the theory's vindication on per-socket emitters — the outline never misstates what was concluded when.
All 20 source_spans have correct character offsets and land on genuinely relevant text; no span is off-topic, misattributed, or contradicts its sentence.
Every verified sentence is factually accurate with correct numbers (65 vs 26.5 MB/min slopes, +14,382 WebSockets, 50k cap, 5-min TTL, 0.02 MB/min flat soak) and correct attribution.

Complete, contiguous turn coverage (t000-t049, no gaps or overlaps) with boundaries at real topic shifts; the narrative arc reproduce -> diff -> dead end -> cache fix -> residual leak -> revisit -> root cause -> verify is fully preserved.
Titles are mostly specific and navigable within 15 chars (e.g. 'Listener Parked', 'Leak Ongoing', 'Retainer Path').
overall_comment: A faithful, well-segmented outline of a two-bug leak hunt: every checked sentence is accurate, all 20 spans point at genuine supporting text, and the tricky abandoned-then-vindicated listener hypothesis is represented with unusual precision. The main weaknesses are omission of the user's standing process constraints (no prod restarts, 10-minute soak bar, no new dependencies) from any summary, one mid-word truncated title, and a habit of backing multi-clause sentences with a single span so several accurate clauses go unevidenced. Usable for navigation and trustworthy on outcomes, with modest gaps in constraint coverage and span completeness.
